description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of Muhammathismail Kairunnisa as a member to the Potthuvil Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Pottuvil Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections.
